title: Free generation gets a clearer path
summary:
Free generation got a clearer entry point, two chat projects joined the list, and image and search requests got less mysterious.

Enter added a registry for text and image generation services. Free services can be called without an API key, while generation requests now record model use, timing and response status.

The Chat Projects list added @mmojocoder’s minimal Strapick Chat and @yassineAbou’s LLMS, a cross-platform app for text chat and image generation.

Nano Banana now times out slow image requests and treats responses without image data as errors instead of passing them through. The image model registry also dropped its Azure-backed gptimage entry.

highlights.title: Keyless free generation
highlights.text: Call free registered generation services without an API key. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
